abstract: As part of the Advanced Media Workflow Association’s (AMWA) Networked Media Open Specifications (NMOS) suite of specifications, Interface Specification (IS)-07 is intended to serve as a generic mechanism for the processing and handling of control and status indication data found in the next generation Internet Protocol (IP)-based television systems. The capabilities of IS-07 are greater than just the simple onand offstates that are typical of common general-purpose input/output (GPIO) schemes.

authors.bio: Arne Bönninghoff is the Head of IP Research with Riedel Communications, Wuppertal, Germany, for four years. Currently, he leads a team of four engineers who are working on Riedel’s IP roadmap. He has participated in many interops and is an active participant in several industry organizations including the Audio Engineering Society, Advanced Media Workflow Association, and SMPTE. Before joining Riedel, Bönninghoff was an accomplished audio and video engineer for live productions. He received an engineering diploma from Fachhochschule Düsseldorf, Germany and resides in Mülheim Ruhr, Germany.
